convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom to load 'ForexProfitBoost_2nb' custom indicator and depends on TradeAlgorithms.mqh external library for all trade execution functions (BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, GlobalVariableDel_). Signal logic is custom-indicator-based (buffer reading) rather than built-in indicator crossover.

derived_values.name: TimeShiftSec - seconds per bar for signal timestamp
min_rates_total - minimum bars required for indicator calculation

long.right: ForexProfitBoost_2nb buffer 2 (Dn arrow at SignalBar+1) also present

short.right: ForexProfitBoost_2nb buffer 4 (Up arrow at SignalBar+1) also present

other_exits: BuyPosClose and SellPosClose input flags can disable signal-based closing; the library functions handle actual close logic which is not visible in this EA code

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MMMode input selects between LOT (fixed lots) and other margin modes; MM=0.1 interpreted as fraction when MMMode is not LOT, or as lot size when MMMode=LOT. Exact logic in TradeAlgorithms.mqh library.

custom_logic_notes: Signal logic reads 2 consecutive bars from custom indicator buffers (Up=buffer4, Dn=buffer2). Long entry requires Up[1]!=EMPTY_VALUE AND Dn[0]!=EMPTY_VALUE — meaning an up arrow on the signal bar AND a down arrow on the previous bar (confirmation flip). Short entry requires Dn[1]!=EMPTY_VALUE AND Up[0]!=EMPTY_VALUE — a down arrow on signal bar AND an up arrow on the previous bar. SignalBar=1 means the EA evaluates bar index 1 (previous completed bar) and bar index 0 (current forming bar). BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/SellPosClose/BuyPosClose are input toggles that gate each action. Recount flag causes signal recalculation on next tick if CopyBuffer fails. The CIsNewBar class from TradeAlgorithms.mqh controls per-bar evaluation.
python_conversion_notes: The ForexProfitBoost_2nb custom indicator must be replicated in Python: it combines two MAs (EMA7 and SMA21) with Bollinger Bands (period 15, deviation 1, shift 1) to produce up/down arrow signals on buffers 2 and 4. The arrow logic (when buffer values are non-EMPTY_VALUE) is not visible here and must be reverse-engineered from the indicator source. The TradeAlgorithms.mqh library functions (BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose) handle position checks, lot sizing, and order placement — these must be reimplemented. The CIsNewBar class must be replaced with a bar-detection mechanism. SL/TP of 1000/2000 points are in broker points (not pips) — need to account for 5-digit vs 4-digit brokers. The SignalBar=1 + reading bars [0] and [1] means the strategy evaluates a 2-bar pattern for confirmation flips.
